title: oh-my-slam API bodies
description: Schema version oms/2.3. Units: metres, degrees, seconds. Map frame: x, y horizontal, z up, yaw counter-clockwise from +x. Camera frame: x right, y down, z forward. T_a_b is the 4x4 pose of b in a, row-major nested arrays. Binary arrays are base64 of little-endian data, row-major.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version of the body, oms/2.<minor>; minors are additive.

Mat4.description: 4x4 homogeneous transform as nested row-major arrays: M[row][col]. T_map_cam is the pose of the camera's optical frame (z forward, x right, y down) in the map frame.

Polygon.description: Closed polygon in map x, y (first point not repeated).

PartName.description: Name of a multipart file part of the same request.

scale_sigma_rel.description: One-sigma relative uncertainty of the map scale, from image-confirmed frames only; the relative error of any horizontal distance, in every direction, stays within 3 x scale_sigma_rel.

ignore_mask.description: 8-bit PNG of the image size; non-zero pixels are ignored (e.g. the robot's own body). Pixels in it (or in a frame's own mask) contribute nothing anywhere, on every engine.

depth_scale_m.description: Metres per unit of this camera's 16-bit depth PNGs.

height_above_floor_m.description: Height of the optical centre above the floor, when known (scale anchor).

Prior.description: A prior without sigmas takes fixed defaults: metric 0.05 m / 2 deg, drifting 0.20 m / 5 deg. Clients should always send sigmas.

name.description: Unique within the map; a name the map or request already holds is rejected duplicate, whatever the image.

height_above_floor_m.description: Height of this frame's optical centre above the floor, known from the robot's joints; overrides the camera's. Scale anchor for camera-only maps.

ignore_mask.description: Per-frame 8-bit PNG mask, non-zero = ignore; combined with the camera's ignore_mask. Combined with the camera's mask; a pixel in the union contributes nothing anywhere (no keypoints, matches, depth, occupancy, free-space or floor evidence, detections, votes or cloud points), on every engine.

max_residual_m.description: Gates previous_residuals.max_m (stored keyframes) only; new-frame disagreement is gated by max_displacement_*; prior corrections never fail it.

max_displacement_m.description: Gates quality.max_displacement_m; a null value passes.

max_displacement_deg.description: Gates quality.max_displacement_deg, including frames unconstrained in translation; a null value passes.

max_prior_disagreement_deg.description: Gates quality.prior_disagreement_deg, so a client can refuse an update that bends its priors. No gate when left out.

items.description: A text prompt, 1-64 characters after trimming.

labels.description: oms/2.3: text prompts added to the map's label vocabulary (the union over all its updates). Detection prompts with the default vocabulary merged with the map's, duplicates removed from the prompt list: labels are equal when their Unicode case-folded forms are equal after trimming, reading _ as a space and collapsing whitespace runs. A label equal to a default stays in the stored vocabulary. An invalid label refuses the request with invalid_request (details.field labels).

RejectReason.description: unusable_image: the image does not decode or its size is not the camera's; the only rejection for a frame with a prior whose image fails a check (plain, blur, few_features make it kept_at_prior). duplicate: a name the map or request already holds, or a pose duplicate (within 0.02 m and 2 deg of a stored confirmed keyframe or another frame registered in the job (the later-named frame of a pair is the duplicate), same camera) whose image also agrees (>= 90 % features re-matched; no detection is run); duplicate_of names that frame. prior_conflict: the images confirm a pose farther than 3 x sqrt(sigma_prior^2 + sigma_hypothesis^2) from the prior (position and rotation separately) and no supported hypothesis lies within that bound; sigma_hypothesis is the image-only calibrated sigma, before fusion with the prior and without rival inflation; for a drifting prior, sigma_prior is the drift-grown sigma. A frame with a prior that fails a check or is too close stays kept_at_prior with that reason even when its image strongly conflicts with its prior. prior_conflict also: a drifting-prior frame left out of the robust drift fit, or unsupporting a refused drift change (when its image-only pose meets the measurable-pair threshold; otherwise kept_at_prior, conflict_unsupported). In an update, a frame failing its prior checks is rejected prior_conflict only when its image-only pose meets the measurable-pair threshold (>= 100 inliers and >= 10 % overlap, both with the same confirmed or registered reference); a frame failing a looseness test is kept_at_prior with loose_image_pose, whatever else it fails; otherwise it is kept_at_prior with detail conflict_unsupported.

status.description: provisional: registered, not yet fused (O3 two-phase). kept_at_prior: a frame with a prior its images did not confirm (or whose image failed a check: reason the first of plain, blur, few_features, too_close); with a metric prior its pose and sigmas are the prior's; with a drifting prior its pose is the prior mapped through the current drift estimate, its sigmas drift-grown: root sum of squares of the prior's (or 0.20 m / 5 deg) and the drift estimate's own sigma at that pose, which grows away from the supporting frames; prior residuals 0; it counts only for free-by-rule grid cells until registered (no occupancy, heights, cloud or objects), except a frame kept only for too_close with a metric prior, whose detections and in-range depth contribute at the prior pose (never scale evidence), and locate never uses it as a reference.

reason.description: Null for registered and provisional; set for rejected and kept_at_prior.

sigma_pos_m.description: Includes the image-registration noise, calibrated so that update.sigma_containment is met. 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

sigma_rot_deg.description: Includes the image-registration noise, calibrated so that update.sigma_containment is met. 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

prior_residual_m.description: Residual between the committed pose and the frame's prior; null without a prior.

prior_residual_deg.description: Residual between the committed pose and the frame's prior; null without a prior.

min_distance_m.description: With reason too_close: the distance limit applied.

scene_distance_m.description: With reason too_close: the frame's median scene depth.

duplicate_of.description: With reason duplicate: the frame it duplicates. A name duplicate (a name the map or request already holds) is always rejected. A pose duplicate (registered pose within 0.02 m and 2 deg, defaults configurable below 0.05 m / 5 deg, of a stored confirmed keyframe or another frame registered in the job (one pass after the registration fixed point, in canonical name order; the later-named frame of a pair is the duplicate), same camera) is rejected only when its image also agrees: >= 90 % of features re-matched (no detection is run); otherwise it is registered. A duplicate is always rejected, never kept_at_prior. Kept even if the partner ends differently when the fixed point is re-run (at most once per job).

detail.description: For a kept_at_prior frame whose images did not confirm it: why (no image pose; image pose too loose; conflicting image pose without enough support to reject). Null otherwise, including a frame kept for a failed check. loose_image_pose wins whatever else the frame fails. conflict_unsupported: beyond the conflict bound without meeting the measurable-pair threshold (>= 100 inliers and >= 10 % overlap with the same confirmed or registered reference).

scale_ratio_vs_prev.description: New scale over the previous version's; null on a map's first update.

gauge_shift.description: Similarity aligning a re-estimated result back onto the previous version. For an engine that never re-poses stored frames: the median translation and rotation of the previous version's keyframes between their previous pose and the pose that would be committed (scale_ratio 1); about 0 when none moved.

max_displacement_m.description: Largest translation, over the update's new frames, between the committed pose and the prior as sent (frames with a prior; a drifting prior as placed through the drift estimate) or the image-only pose (frames without a prior; those unconstrained in translation, two-view parallax below 1 px against every reference, are left out); kept_at_prior and rejected frames excluded; null when there is none.

max_displacement_deg.description: Largest rotation, over the same frames (frames without a prior unconstrained in translation included), between the committed pose and the prior as sent or the image-only pose; null when there is none.

previous_residuals.description: Earlier keyframes only (count <= the previous version's keyframes) against their previous version's poses; a stored keyframe moving beyond tolerance shows in max_m / max_deg and is gated by max_residual_m.

prior_disagreement_deg.description: Largest disagreement, over pairs of the update's frames overlapping by at least 50 % (overlap: 8x8 inlier-cell coverage, map.md §1), between the images' relative rotation and the priors' relative rotation; 0 when none. Beyond 3 x hypot of the two frames' prior rotation sigmas the rotation is corrected from the images.

failed_checks.description: prior_frames_rejected: every prior-carrying frame of a map's first update was rejected; no version is committed and no map created. An engine that cannot tie kept frames to the priors' frame, when no prior-carrying frame of the first update registers, may also reject with it. rotation_inconsistent (updates without priors only, every engine): committed relative rotations of overlapping neighbours disagree with the image-measured ones by more than 3 deg in median over the pairs, or more than 10 deg on any pair. Pair limits are measured on registered frames only, over measurable pairs (>= 100 epipolar inliers of a pose confirmed by the pair's depth images when both frames carry depth, else consistent with the chain of stronger pairs); with no measurable pair, every pair limit passes. hard_limit fails only an update that registers nothing and keeps nothing.

reregistered.description: One entry per stored kept_at_prior frame this job's images confirmed (the service re-runs the registration of stored kept frames that the new frames overlap): how far confirmation moved it from its prior-placed pose. This movement is excluded from previous_residuals and gauge_shift. Empty when none; a dry run predicts it with the same test. Eligible with at least 10 % 8x8 inlier-cell coverage of the kept frame's image by a new registered frame and at least the registration minimum of inliers; confirmed by images only, never depth, and only when its fitted pose passes the prior checks. The dry-run prediction is approximate. An engine that cannot re-register reports an empty list.

height_inconsistent.description: Names of frames whose committed camera height disagrees with their height_above_floor_m by more than 3 x sqrt(height_sigma^2 + sigma_z^2), sigma_z = sigma_pos_m / sqrt(3); they contribute nothing to occupancy, heights or objects, and their status is unchanged. Empty when none.

a.description: Frame name, first in canonical order.

b.description: Frame name, second in canonical order.

difference_deg.description: Angle between the measured and the committed relative rotations.

rotation_pairs.description: Every measurable pair the rotation check evaluated (jobs and dry runs); empty unless it ran on at least one measurable pair. Shows which pairs drove rotation_inconsistent.

eta_s.description: Seconds until the job ends: from queueing, the queue ahead plus its own predicted registration and fusion.

base_version.description: Version registration ran against; null for a new map and while the job is queued. A queued job starts from the latest version at that moment, a reverted one included, and reports the version it actually ran on.

latest_version.description: Newest version this job has committed so far (provisional, fusing or final); null before any.

min_distance_m.description: With reason too_close: the distance limit applied.

scene_distance_m.description: With reason too_close: the frame's median scene depth.

duplicate_of.description: With reason duplicate: the frame it duplicates. A name duplicate (a name the map or request already holds) is always rejected. A pose duplicate (registered pose within 0.02 m and 2 deg, defaults configurable below 0.05 m / 5 deg, of a stored confirmed keyframe or another frame registered in the job (one pass after the registration fixed point, in canonical name order; the later-named frame of a pair is the duplicate), same camera) is rejected only when its image also agrees: >= 90 % of features re-matched (no detection is run); otherwise it is registered. A duplicate is always rejected, never kept_at_prior. Kept even if the partner ends differently when the fixed point is re-run (at most once per job).

labels.description: oms/2.3: the vocabulary detection would use: the defaults merged with the map's vocabulary and the request's labels, duplicates removed (equal after Unicode case-folding, trimming, _ read as a space and whitespace runs collapsed).
oms/2.3: the version's label vocabulary (read-only): the union of its updates' labels, without the defaults. A label equal to a default stays here.

sigma_pos_m.description: 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

sigma_rot_deg.description: 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

pose_state.description: provisional: registered, not yet fused. kept_at_prior: the prior, unconfirmed by the images; counts only for free-by-rule grid cells (except a frame kept only for too_close with a metric prior: its detections and in-range depth contribute) until a later job's images confirm it, when it becomes a registered pose in that version; never a locate reference.

id.description: Map object id. In an AnalysisObject: the map's persistent id (unique across the map's whole version history, never reused) when the detection matched a map object (map and T_map_cam given), else a local id >= 1000000.

size_m.description: x = longer horizontal side, y, z = height.

sigma_centre_m.description: One-sigma uncertainty of the centre; when the bounding views were never recorded, from the formula documented in README.md.

extent_seen.description: full or partial per box axis, from the views that bound it; a view of the top seen uncut with a support plane measured under the footprint makes z full; partial on every axis when the map's builder never recorded those views.

color.description: Display colour, a pure function of id; not the object's appearance.

ObjectCore.description: Fields shared by MapObject and AnalysisObject.

share.description: Frames that gave this label over image-confirmed frames whose view frustum contains the box centre, detected or not, plus every confirmed frame that detected the object (kept_at_prior excluded, except frames kept only for too_close with a metric prior); for older-mapper maps, that mapper's per-label vote counts over its observing frames.

detection_votes.description: Highest share first; shares sum to at most 1, and may sum to less. detected_as is unchanged.

MapObject.description: An object record of an objects read (map.md §5).

AnalysisObject.description: A detection of a frame analysis: the frame-analysis subset of an object, plus bbox_px.

centre_m.description: Midpoint of the free gap between the jambs.

width_m.description: Free width at the narrowest point within the height band, open leaves counted as obstacles.

normal_deg.description: Perpendicular to the jamb line, from regions[0] to regions[1] (or toward the unobserved side).

regions.description: [a, b], or [a, null] for a doorway whose far side was never observed (frontier then names it).

kind.description: door when a leaf (door object) is found, so leaves is not empty; else opening. narrow: deprecated, not produced since oms/2.2; see the narrow field.

jambs_m.description: End points of the free gap at floor level.

leaf.description: Deprecated: leaves[0], or null when leaves is empty.

object_id.description: The leaf's object id (label door) in the objects read.

leaves.description: Door leaves found at the passage; empty when none.

narrow.description: width_m below 2 x footprint_radius_m; null when footprint_radius_m is not given.

frontier.description: When regions[1] is null: the frontier on the unobserved side; else null.

origin_m.description: Map x, y of the corner of cell [0, 0].

z_band_m.description: [z_min, z_max] relative to floor_z_m, as requested.

floor_z_m.description: Absolute map-frame z of the floor estimate: with priors, the large plane nearest the priors' origin height; without priors but with a camera height, the floor plane the height defines (about 0), refined by an observed plane within 3 sigma; otherwise the lowest large plane below the cameras.

floor_sigma_m.description: Spread (standard deviation) of the floor points' heights, not the uncertainty of their mean; the floor band is max(0.06, 3 x floor_sigma_m) on either side of floor_z_m. With a camera height and no priors: the point spread of the observed plane nearest the height-defined floor, accepted within 3 x that spread.

height_cap_m.description: Ceiling of the height_m layer, relative to floor_z_m: the request's height_cap_m, default 2.0 or the requested z_max.

height_m.description: float32 highest surface in the cell at or below height_cap_m, relative to floor_z_m; NaN if none.

floor_observed.description: uint8: 1 floor observed at floor height; 2 not observed but free by rule (camera stand or its near blind disc); 0 not observed.

pixel_to_map.description: 2x3 affine: [x, y] = A [u, v, 1], where (u, v) are the integer column and row indices of a pixel; A maps them to the centre of pixel (u, v).

height_above_floor_m.description: Height of this frame's optical centre above the floor, known from the robot's joints; overrides the camera's. Scale anchor for camera-only maps.

ignore_mask.description: Per-frame 8-bit PNG mask, non-zero = ignore; combined with the camera's ignore_mask.

reason.description: few_features: fewer keypoints than a pose needs inliers (README constant, currently 15). no_overlap: enough keypoints but no pose; carries nearest_view when the frame has a prior. prior_conflict: with a prior, no hypothesis of support >= 0.25 lies within 3 x sqrt(sigma_prior^2 + sigma_hypothesis^2) of the prior, position and rotation tested separately (defaults for a prior without sigmas: metric 0.05 m / 2 deg, drifting 0.20 m / 5 deg).

T_map_cam.description: With a prior: among hypotheses with support >= 0.25 within 3 x sqrt(sigma_prior^2 + sigma_hypothesis^2) of the prior (position and rotation separately), the nearest the prior by hypot(dp / sqrt(sigma_pos_prior^2 + sigma_pos_hyp^2), dr / sqrt(sigma_rot_prior^2 + sigma_rot_hyp^2)).

sigma_pos_m.description: From the images alone (trust class none): hypot(scale x covariance sigma, noise floor); the prior never changes it. Combined with the reference keyframe's map sigma only while locate.sigma_containment and locate.sigma_tightness_bound hold. 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

sigma_rot_deg.description: From the images alone (trust class none): hypot(scale x covariance sigma, noise floor); the prior never changes it. Combined with the reference keyframe's map sigma only while locate.sigma_containment and locate.sigma_tightness_bound hold. 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

ambiguity.description: The strongest supported rival (rivals[0]), or null: non-null whenever a rival hypothesis farther than 0.10 m or 5 deg from the reported pose has support >= 0.25 (its inlier count over the best hypothesis's, <= 1), whatever else its inliers explain.

support.description: Rival's inlier count over the best hypothesis's inlier count.

rivals.description: Every supported rival (support >= 0.25, farther than 0.10 m or 5 deg), strongest first; empty when none. Rivals within 0.10 m and 5 deg of each other are de-duplicated: only the strongest is listed.

consistent_with_prior.description: Null without a prior; always true for a located frame with a prior, since a frame that no supported hypothesis matches within 3 x sqrt(sigma_prior^2 + sigma_hypothesis^2) (position and rotation separately) is rejected with prior_conflict.

height_consistent.description: When the map's scale_source is camera_height: false when |z_located - z_expected| > 3 x sqrt(height_sigma^2 + sigma_z^2), sigma_z = sigma_rel / sqrt(3); z_expected is the floor height plus the locate frame's height_above_floor_m, else the camera's registered height; height_sigma is, in order: the locate frame's height_sigma_m; else the median height_sigma_m the answer's reference keyframes carried when sent; else the median sigma_pos_m / sqrt(3) of the registered (image-confirmed) reference keyframes, kept references skipped; else the README default. The reported position sigma is hypot(sigma_rel, |z_located - z_expected|). Such a hypothesis ranks below any height-consistent rival. Null without any height (sigma = sigma_rel) or another scale source.

turn_deg.description: Signed turn (CCW positive) from the frame's prior heading toward that keyframe's view; null without a prior.

nearest_view.description: For no_overlap rejections: the most similar keyframe, else null. Only confirmed keyframes qualify, never a kept_at_prior one.

map_version.description: The version the pose was located in. GET pose takes no ?version.

sigma_pos_m.description: 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

sigma_rot_deg.description: 3-D RMS: sigma^2 is the trace of the position (or rotation) covariance; the same meaning for every engine.

map.description: With camera_id: take the camera, and the scale, from this map.

ignore_mask.description: Per-frame 8-bit PNG mask, non-zero = ignore; combined with the camera's ignore_mask.

bearing_deg.description: With T_map_cam: direction in the map frame, CCW from map +x, range from the camera position projected on the floor. Without: CCW from the camera's viewing direction (gravity_camera frame).

depth.description: uint16 depth, metres = value x depth_scale_m (0.001); 0 = no value.

lanes.description: With lanes: interactive and bulk. Without lanes, one lane, worker: the service's single job worker, its state and queue length.

capabilities.description: Groups the running service implements. "O3-jobs": asynchronous jobs (202 + GET/poll) without the two-phase provisional commit, cancel or lanes. O10 may be claimed without lanes, provided a dry run never waits behind fusion.

code.description: invalid_request also answers an unknown route (HTTP 404) and a wrong method (HTTP 405).

field.description: For invalid_request: the body field or query parameter at fault, e.g. "version" on GET pose.

details.description: Machine-readable context; internal names the failing stage.

truncated.description: True when max_points cut the result; the kept points are an even voxel thinning.

id.description: Surface id: unique across the map's whole version history and never reused, even after a revert.
